modules.title: Deterministic classical FISTA MRI reconstruction
modules.expensive_path: Repeated 2-D FFT/IFFT, Cartesian mask application, total-variation proximal updates, and line-search iterations over a synthetic 32x32 phantom.
modules.rationale: These files form the deterministic CPU reconstruction path and are covered directly by test_fista.py plus the k-space and synthetic-data fixtures. Keeping the operator, data fixture, and solver together preserves the MRI reconstruction observable rather than splitting the numerical contract across unrelated modules.
excluded: algorithms/ai/: U-Net training and inference require PyTorch, model configuration and data not needed for a short deterministic CPU task.
evaluation/, visualization/, notebooks/ and report/ assets: downstream metrics, plotting and presentation are not part of the reconstruction kernel.
tests/integration/test_pipeline.py: retained as an official test but not claimed as a FISTA-only unit boundary.
latex/ generated auxiliary files and documentation figures: presentation artifacts are not numerical implementation paths.
hazards: FFT normalization, complex-to-real conversion and Cartesian mask indexing must remain consistent.
The TV transform/adjoint and soft-threshold step are sensitive to boundary conventions and regularization parameters.
Line-search and BLAS/FFT implementations can produce small floating-point differences across legitimate environments.
The repository advertises optional CUDA/PyTorch paths, but this source review does not claim GPU or clinical-data coverage.
modules.purpose: Reconstructs a real-valued image from undersampled Cartesian k-space with TV-regularized FISTA iterations and optional line search.
primary_outputs: convergence metadata: iterations, cost history, step sizes and status
algorithm_stages: gradient of sampled k-space data fidelity
TV transform and soft-threshold proximal update
line search, convergence tracking and reconstruction output
not_responsible_for: algorithms/ai/: U-Net training/inference and model weights
clinical/raw fastMRI data or network downloads
